purpose: Teach: ルピー/一室/座敷/刺す/ザル/ローテーション/そりゃあ/ちまう

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、社会科で、本気で、絶対、ルピー、絶対、習ったよね
lines.en: Riku, you definitely learned about the rupee in social studies, right?
lines.style: Bright, playful challenge. Quick tempo, slight lilt on the name. Testing whether he'll remember what they studied together.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お祖父ちゃんち、本気で、絶対、一室、絶対、俺の、絶対、勉強部屋、絶対、なんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. Grandpa's place—one room became my study room, Sakura. Seriously.
lines.style: Quiet, almost defensive pride. Slight hesitation before explaining, like he's used to being teased about it. Measured cadence, grounded.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お正月、本気で、絶対、座敷、絶対、家族で、絶対、集まったよね、リク
lines.en: And at New Year's, the whole family packed into that tatami room, remember?
lines.style: Soft affection threading through the words. Nostalgic tempo. Voice brightens slightly on the memory, then settles into warmth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 家庭科で、本気で、絶対、指を、絶対、刺す、絶対、ことなく、絶対、お裁縫、絶対、できたぜ、桜
lines.en: In home ec I managed not to stab my finger once while sewing, Sakura. Not once.
lines.style: Dry triumph barely hidden. Slow, deliberate pronunciation of the accomplishment. Slight smile in the voice—he knows it's small but he's genuinely proud.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夏休みに、本気で、絶対、ザル、絶対、お蕎麦、絶対、家族で、絶対、食べたよ、リク
lines.en: Last summer we all ate cold soba together on that bamboo strainer, didn't we, Riku?
lines.style: Animated, summery brightness. Quick pace, emphasis on the shared memory. Voice carries genuine delight in the recollection.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活の、本気で、絶対、ローテーション、絶対、しっかり、絶対、組んでるぜ、桜
lines.en: With the club rotation schedule I've been keeping it solid, Sakura. Really solid.
lines.style: Quiet confidence without boasting. Steady rhythm, slight emphasis on 'solid.' The tone of someone showing something they've built, not bragging.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そりゃあ、本気で、絶対、お前、絶対、頑張ってるもの、絶対、私、絶対、応援するよ、リク
lines.en: Of course I'm going to support you—look how hard you're trying, Riku.
lines.style: Sincere and direct, the teasing dropped for a moment. Warm eyes in the voice. Slight lean forward quality, like she means every word.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活帰り、本気で、絶対、コンビニで、絶対、おにぎり、絶対、食べちまう、絶対、ぜ、桜
lines.en: After club I end up grabbing rice balls at the convenience store every time, though.
lines.style: Rueful, self-aware laugh barely underneath. Relaxed, casual rhythm. Slight resignation on the admission—he knows it's not the healthiest habit but he's made peace with it.
